title: Talas 751: The Captives Who Carried Paper West
summary: Tells of the single encounter between Tang China and the newly founded Abbasid Caliphate on the banks of the Talas River, on today's Kyrgyzstan–Kazakhstan border, in July seven hundred and fifty-one, and how the Tang army fell apart when the Karluks changed sides in the middle of the fight. The episode follows the Chinese artisans taken captive to trace how papermaking travelled to Samarkand and Baghdad, asks how much of that account is true, and covers the Tang withdrawal from Central Asia.
